title: GitLab week 3 review - variables, rules and job controls
description: Eight questions on precedence, predefined variables, rules, workflow and the keywords that bound a job.

questions.prompt: A job-level variables: entry and a project (UI) variable share a name. Which value does script see?

options.text: The project one - the UI always wins
The job-level one - the YAML is more specific than the project

questions.explanation: Precedence: job-level YAML beats global YAML beats project/group/instance; only pipeline-run values beat the file.

questions.prompt: What does a File-type variable put in $VAR?

options.text: The path to a temporary file holding the value
Nothing - it is only for artifacts

questions.explanation: File variables are the right shape for kubeconfigs, SSH keys and the like.

questions.prompt: Which predefined variable tells a job it was started by a schedule?
questions.explanation: CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE carries the trigger: push, merge_request_event, schedule, web, api, trigger.

questions.prompt: Two rules in a job: if: A then if: B. The pipeline matches both. Which applies?
questions.explanation: Rules are evaluated top to bottom; the first match decides.

questions.prompt: A manual job without allow_failure: false - what happens to the next stage?

options.text: It runs without waiting, because manual jobs are allowed to fail by default

questions.explanation: Add allow_failure: false to turn a manual job into a blocking gate.

questions.prompt: Which mechanism stops a branch push that has an open MR from creating a second (branch) pipeline?

options.text: workflow:rules with a when: never for branches that have open merge requests

questions.explanation: workflow:rules decides whether the pipeline exists at all.

questions.prompt: Two pipelines run deploy-staging within a minute. What guarantees the deployments do not overlap?
questions.explanation: A resource group is a named mutex across pipelines.

questions.prompt: A test job needs Redis. How does it get one and reach it?

options.text: services: [redis:7] - reachable by hostname (alias or image name)

questions.explanation: services: start containers alongside the job on a shared network.
